summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. 80/80 backend pytest cases pass (18 new iter-4 tests covering Wearables CRUD+events, bathroom zones+insights, Device Tokens admin-only+create/revoke+HMAC soft-enforcement on /pendants/event, Family Portal public summary+invalid-token+acknowledge-read). Frontend Admin correctly shows all 10 tabs (Residents, Pendants, Wearables, Staff, Kiosks, Zones, Family, Device tokens, Insights, Roadmap). Wearables 'Pair wearable' + 'Simulate event' dialogs work (event fires POST /api/wearables/event). Device tokens 'Create token' reveals shared secret in secret-reveal-dialog with copy buttons and revoke works. Family tab shows copy-portal-{id} buttons on every contact row. Public /family/{token} renders a calm, no-login resident view (resident name, last-seen zone, active calls, resolved last 7d, 4 recent alert summaries, mark-read-btn). /family/invalid-xyz shows friendly 'Link not valid' card.

issues: Radix DialogContent still missing <DialogDescription> / aria-describedby - repeated a11y console warnings. Non-blocking but recommended for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional) Add <DialogDescription> to all Radix Dialog components to silence repeated a11y warnings (WearablesTab pair/simulate dialogs, DeviceTokensTab create/reveal dialogs).

(Optional) The /api/insights/compute success response is a dict {computed, residents} while /api/insights returns a list - consistent, but worth documenting in API spec so future consumers don't miss it.
critical_code_review_comments: device_auth.verify_device_token does NOT actually verify HMAC - comment on L63-66 admits it accepts any non-empty signature as long as token_id is valid. This means an attacker who steals a token_id can spoof signatures without the shared_secret. Should either (a) register a middleware that buffers raw body and recomputes HMAC, or (b) document this as a token-presence-only check until full HMAC is wired. Right now the 'HMAC' claim is misleading.

wearables.py create_wearable/update_wearable do not validate unique mac_address - a duplicate POST with the same mac_address silently creates a second wearable doc. Consider a unique index or pre-check.

wearables.py uses triggered_by='pendant' for all wearable-generated alerts (L132) - this loses signal for analytics/UI that want to distinguish wearable vs pendant origin. Add 'wearable' to Alert.triggered_by Literal and use it.

family_portal.py /summary has no rate limit - a leaked portal_token allows unlimited fetches. For MVP it's fine, but consider per-token throttle (e.g., 60 req/min) before production. Also consider rotating/expiring tokens (currently stored as permanent strings via seed backfill).
family_portal acknowledge-read accepts empty body but route signature still expects POST - works fine, but a 'note' field (optional text) would be valuable to capture family sentiment.

insights.py bathroom_frequency_7d denominator handling was not directly verifiable on live seed (no active bathroom pings) - add a unit test that seeds locations in a bathroom zone and asserts the metric fires.

DeviceTokensTab secret-value is an <Input readOnly> - correct UX (select+copy) but makes automated inner-text extraction return empty; worth leaving a test comment so future agents use el.inputValue() or getAttribute('value').
